segments.text: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

footnotes.text: + Maschil…: or, A Psalm for Ethan the Ezrahite, to give instruction
+ to all…: Heb. to generation and generation

heading: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite

segments.text: For I have said,

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations.
Selah.
And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

footnotes.text: + thy…: Heb. the arm of thy strength

segments.text: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

footnotes.text: + the fulness…: or, all it containeth

segments.text: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

footnotes.text: + a…: Heb. an arm with might

segments.text: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

footnotes.text: + the LORD…: or, our shield is of the LORD, and our king is of the Holy One of Israel

segments.text: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

segments.speaker: Unknown
segments.text: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

footnotes.text: + will…: Heb. I will not make void from him

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven.
Selah.
But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
